primary_sources.title: Pinaki Mondal, Analytic compactifications of C2 part II, arXiv1307.5577v4 (2016)
primary_sources.used_statement: Definition2.8 signed key inequalities on PDF5; Theorem4.6(1) general normal-form existence on PDF11; Definition7.1 and Theorem7.2 general canonical formula on PDF17. All complete pages visually inspected. Applies to any divisorial semidegree, including negative last key values, without a primitive-compactification assumption.
